entries.name: initial
entries.type: Context formulas solver inventory beforeCaller memos

entries.name: ranges
entries.type:
∀ (prefixFuel : Nat) (recorded : List Nat) (winner : Nat)
      (moved : EnumerationWaitingIndex.Waiting) (joined : EnumerationState.State Symbol Constraint),
      ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationTerminalPrefix.run prefixFuel first rest before.waiting before.core) =
        [.ok ((recorded, winner, moved), joined)] →
      SourcePruningEnumerationFold.Ranges checkEmpty recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query ∧
      ∀ (foldFuel P H : Nat) (foldCaller : Caller width)
        (folded : EnumerationState.State Symbol Constraint) (foldQueries : Queries),
        SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run checkEmpty foldFuel P H recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query =
          (.ok (some [.ok ((), folded)]), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded) →
        match folded.values[winner]? with
        | some (.unenumerated (some oldHandle) _) =>
            match lookupNode foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap oldHandle with
            | some old => SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeRequestBounds.WordRanges
                (.code (SourceRecursiveIntersectionCode.requestNode IntersectionEmptyDomain.emptyDomain incoming old))
                foldCaller.checked
            | none => True
        | _ => True

entries.name: (prefix observed)
entries.type: ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationTerminalPrefix.run prefixFuel first rest before.waiting before.core) = [.ok ((recorded, winner, moved), joined)]

entries.name: (fold observed)
entries.type: SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run checkEmpty foldFuel P H recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query = (.ok (some [.ok ((), folded)]), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded)

entries.name: (implicit frame argument)
entries.note: Existing frame partial application; no new lambda declaration.

entries.name: prefixRun
entries.type: ∀ extra, ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationTerminalPrefix.run (r + extra) first rest before.waiting before.core) = [.ok ((recorded, winner, joined.waiting), joined.core)]

entries.name: movedSame
entries.type: joined.waiting = EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.moveMany winner (EnumerationBuilderCaches.canonicalIds (recorded.filter (fun key => key != winner))) before.waiting

entries.name: prefixCounts
entries.type: EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) joined.core.values joined.waiting

entries.name: cachedFoldRun
entries.type: ∀ extra P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationCachedFold.run checkEmpty (n + extra) P H recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query = ((.ok (some (foldRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded.core), some folded)

entries.name: foldRun
entries.type: ∀ extra P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run checkEmpty (n + extra) P H recorded beforeCaller joined.core winner memos.query = (.ok (some (foldRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded.core)

entries.type: Post formulas solver foldInventory beforeCaller foldCaller foldFinal

entries.name: foldCounts
entries.type: EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) folded.core.values folded.waiting

entries.name: foldCompleted
entries.type: foldRows = [((), folded)] → ∀ source ∈ recorded, source ≠ winner → folded.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated

entries.name: terminalRun
entries.type: ∀ extraRepresentative extraNative P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationTerminal.run checkEmpty (r + extraRepresentative) (n + extraNative) P H first rest before.waiting beforeCaller before.core incoming incomingScs memos.query = (.ok (some raw), afterCaller, savedQueries, outer, joined.waiting)

entries.name: post
entries.type: Post formulas solver next beforeCaller afterCaller final

entries.name: rejectedBranch
entries.type: foldRows = [] → raw = [] ∧ afterCaller = foldCaller ∧ savedQueries = foldQueries ∧ outer = folded.core ∧ final = foldFinal ∧ next = foldInventory

entries.name: completedBranch
entries.type: foldRows = [((), folded)] → ∃ (incomingK : Nat) (oldNode : Option Nat) (oldScs : List EnumerationState.Suspended) (read : EnumerationState.State Symbol Constraint) (after : EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint) (replacement : Node) (handle : Nat), (outer = read) ∧ (∀ extra, ExceptT.run (getValue (r + extra) winner folded.core) = [.ok (.unenumerated oldNode oldScs, read)]) ∧ (EnumerationCompressionFrame.Frame folded.core read) ∧ (∀ extraRepresentative extraNative P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationIncomingNode.run checkEmpty (r + extraRepresentative) (n + extraNative) P H foldCaller folded.core winner incoming incomingScs foldQueries = (.ok (some (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok ((), after.core)])), afterCaller, savedQueries, read)) ∧ (ExceptT.run ((do setValue winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)); inheritAncestry winner) read) = [.ok ((), after.core)]) ∧ (after.core = {read with values := read.values.set winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)), recursionAncestry := fun other => if other = winner then (read.expansionAncestry ++ read.recursionAncestry winner).eraseDups else read.recursionAncestry other}) ∧ (after.core.values[winner]? = some (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs))) ∧ (StorageValid after.core) ∧ (PendingRealized afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap after.core) ∧ (Post formulas solver next foldCaller afterCaller final) ∧ (Cache.Extends foldFinal.unfolding final.unfolding) ∧ (∀ extra, (SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.write afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap (incomingK + extra) winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)) incomingScs [] (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame read folded)).map (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame after.core) = some after) ∧ (after.core.counter = folded.core.counter) ∧ (after.core.representatives = read.representatives) ∧ (Roots after.core.representatives (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner)) ∧ (EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) after.core.values after.waiting) ∧ (after.waiting = EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.count (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) 1 incomingScs joined.waiting) ∧ (∀ (slot : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.candidate afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ((after.core.values[slot]?).getD .eliminated) = some (after.expandable slot)) ∧ (after.expandable = (fun slot => if slot = winner then !(MergedOrdinaryHeight.recursiveBoundary replacement && (incomingScs ++ oldScs).isEmpty) else folded.expandable slot)) ∧ (raw = (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok (.hole winner, after.core)])) ∧ (FragmentBound after.core.counter (.hole winner : Fragments.Fragment Symbol)) ∧ (Available afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap replacement) ∧ (replacement.free = []) ∧ (encodeNode replacement = some handle) ∧ (lookupNode afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap handle = some replacement) ∧ (oldNode = none → replacement = incoming ∧ afterCaller = foldCaller ∧ savedQueries = foldQueries ∧ final = foldFinal ∧ next = foldInventory) ∧ (∀ oldHandle, oldNode = some oldHandle → ∃ (old query : Node) (queried : Checked width), lookupNode foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap oldHandle = some old ∧ next.source = foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ∧ next.roots = foldInventory.roots ++ [incoming, old] ∧ SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Receipt formulas solver next incoming old foldCaller.checked query queried foldFinal ∧ (∀ ambient term, InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient incoming term ∧ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient old term) ∧ (checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧ afterCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance foldCaller queried foldCaller.fourth foldCaller.merge ∧ final = foldFinal))

entries.name: reading
entries.type: ∀ extra, ExceptT.run (getValue (r + extra) winner folded.core) = [.ok (.unenumerated oldNode oldScs, read)]

entries.name: incomingRun
entries.type: ∀ extraRepresentative extraNative P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationIncomingNode.run checkEmpty (r + extraRepresentative) (n + extraNative) P H foldCaller folded.core winner incoming incomingScs foldQueries = (.ok (some (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok ((), after.core)])), afterCaller, savedQueries, read)

entries.name: writePrefix
entries.type: ExceptT.run ((do setValue winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)); inheritAncestry winner) read) = [.ok ((), after.core)]

entries.name: afterSame
entries.type: after.core = {read with values := read.values.set winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)), recursionAncestry := fun other => if other = winner then (read.expansionAncestry ++ read.recursionAncestry winner).eraseDups else read.recursionAncestry other}

entries.name: incomingPost
entries.type: Post formulas solver next foldCaller afterCaller final

entries.name: cacheRun
entries.type: ∀ extra, (SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.write afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap (incomingK + extra) winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)) incomingScs [] (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame read folded)).map (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame after.core) = some after

entries.name: afterCounts
entries.type: EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) after.core.values after.waiting

entries.name: writeWaiting
entries.type: after.waiting = EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.count (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) 1 incomingScs joined.waiting

entries.name: afterExpandable
entries.type: after.expandable = (fun slot => if slot = winner then !(MergedOrdinaryHeight.recursiveBoundary replacement && (incomingScs ++ oldScs).isEmpty) else folded.expandable slot)

entries.name: rawSame
entries.type: raw = (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok (.hole winner, after.core)])

entries.name: optional
entries.type: oldNode = none → replacement = incoming ∧ afterCaller = foldCaller ∧ savedQueries = foldQueries ∧ final = foldFinal ∧ next = foldInventory

entries.name: present
entries.type: ∀ oldHandle, oldNode = some oldHandle → ∃ (old query : Node) (queried : Checked width), lookupNode foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap oldHandle = some old ∧ next.source = foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ∧ next.roots = foldInventory.roots ++ [incoming, old] ∧ SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Receipt formulas solver next incoming old foldCaller.checked query queried foldFinal ∧ (∀ ambient term, InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient incoming term ∧ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient old term) ∧ (checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧ afterCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance foldCaller queried foldCaller.fourth foldCaller.merge ∧ final = foldFinal)

entries.name: lookup
entries.type: UnionFind.findRoot r folded.core.representatives winner = some found

entries.name: adapted
entries.type: ∀ extraIndex, SourcePruningEnumerationIncomingCacheAdapter.adapt afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap (incomingK + extraIndex) winner incomingScs folded read (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok ((), after.core)]) = some after
